erpFlow.title: Total workflow · Southfield Group
erpFlow.subtitle: How work moves through the ERP for both companies: {{flows}} workflows over {{screens}} screens. Every screen shows its own workflow in a strip under the top bar, with the steps before and after it.
erpFlow.mainLine: The main line · choose a box for its steps

handoffs.h1: Credit orders reserve against the customer’s approved limit
handoffs.h2: Released stock moves on two-person transfers and deliveries
handoffs.h3: Goods receipts go into quarantine, then stores
handoffs.h4: Released materials are picked and issued to each batch
handoffs.h5: Packed lots come back on hold, then are released
handoffs.h6: Released stock is picked, loaded and delivered
handoffs.h7: Received goods pass the incoming test and go into stock
handoffs.h8: Released materials are issued to Biochem batches
handoffs.h9: Granules and parts are issued to moulding and assembly
handoffs.h10: Plastics bills Biochem for trays, containers and lids
handoffs.h11: Released finished lots can be sold
handoffs.h14: Vans and the Kochi and Coimbatore shops are stocked from the factory
handoffs.h15: Salesmen and shops hand over and bank collections daily
handoffs.h17: Payroll and advances are paid from cash and bank
handoffs.h18: Cash and bank feed the books and GST
handoffs.h19: Profit is shared out to partners
handoffs.h20: Tally loads and fixes feed the books
